name: Hittco Tools Limited
about: Hittco Tools Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of machine tools in India. The company is primarily engaged in the production of HSS tools, such as drills, center drills, end mills, and round tool bits. The company also provides solid carbide tools, including end mills, drills, reamers, and special tools, as well as conventional, CNC, special purpose, and metal forming machines. Hittco Tools Limited was founded in 1974 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
